summary.text: Liesa Priddy is the Republican candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 82, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Democrat Arthur Boyer; there is no incumbent in the race.
Priddy won the August 18, 2026 Republican primary with 58.1 percent of the vote over Bill Poteet.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists endorsements for Liesa Priddy from state Representatives Yvette Benarroch, Adam Botana, Lauren Melo and Kiyan Michael, former state Representative Matt Hudson, Americans for Prosperity, Associated Industries of Florida and the Florida Chamber of Commerce, among others.
